steps.name: Search for type of visa required and confirm visa requirements
notices: Tourist - Own Itinerary: This visa is for holiday makers who intend to visit Papua New Guinea for holiday and sight-seeing. This visa is: valid for a single entry; and a period of Sixty (60) days from the date of arrival in Papua New Guinea.

How To Apply: Complete the Online Application or Application for Visa (Form 1); Pay the US$50* online lodgement fee (if applicable); and Provide copy of your passports bio data page. Provide copy of your return/ongoing ticket. Provide evidence of funds(if required).

Easy Visitor Permit (30 days): There is no Migration Service Fee (MSF) payable for the Visitor Permit, however, applications lodged via the e-Visa portal will attract a fee of US$50. ... Extension Of Stay: An extension of stay is not permitted.

Business Short-Term Single Entry: This visa is: valid for a single entry; and a period of thirty (30) days from the date of arrival in Papua New Guinea. ... Pay the Migration Service Fee (MSF) of US$190* and US$50* online lodgement fee (if applicable) ... No extension is allowed for this visa class.
*All MSF and online lodgement fees are levied in US Dollars and converted into PNG Kina (using the published conversion rate) prior to finalisation of application registration.

steps.name: What is your nationality? (Requirements to lodge application)
notices: The following documents need to be provided before the application can be lodged: Cover Letter - (purpose,visit site, accommodation, contact details and addressed to CMO) / Evidence of funds / Return/onward ticket / Copy of Passport BIO Page (Tourist - Own Itinerary)

The following documents need to be provided before the application can be lodged: Letter from PNG based Sponsor / Return/on going ticket / Copy of Passport BIO Page (Business Short-Term Single-Entry, nationality Poland)
After completing the details and uploading the required documents, the application is ready to be submitted. The visa fee must then be paid before the application is automatically submitted.

steps.name: Register to allow notification and enter application
notices: An email will be sent to you at this email address and this will initiate the application process.

steps.name: Home (Important Notice)
notices: The information set out here in is required by Papua New Guinea (PNG) legislation and must be completed by or for, every passenger arriving in PNG.
1. The PNGDAC is NOT a visa — and does not grant permission to enter Papua New Guinea.
2. Complete all sections honestly and accurately — false or misleading information is an offence under Papua New Guinea’s Migration laws.
3. Declare all goods, currency, and items as required — including food, plant or animal products, and amounts over the currency reporting threshold.
4. Answer health and quarantine questions carefully — to protect PNG from pets and diseases.
5. If in doubt, declare — penalties apply for failing to declare prohibited or restricted items.
6. A separate declaration must be completed by, or on behalf of, each incoming person.
You can only complete a declaration 72 hours before arrival into Papua New Guinea
